title: Probability of a Prefix Event
statement: Let $m_1,m\in\mathbb{N}$ with $m_1\le m$, and let $A$ be any property of finite Boolean lists. For a uniformly random Boolean list of length $m$, the probability that its first $m_1$ entries satisfy $A$ equals the probability that a uniformly random Boolean list of length $m_1$ satisfies $A$.
